programs.description: Vijay Govind, a young lecturer in a college, wishes to get married at the earliest. He tries to woo Geetha, an independent and a level-headed woman, who is not easy to convince.
Friends John, Kichu, Roopesh, Bava and Babumon decide to have a party on New Year's Eve. However, a series of events leads to a lot of unpleasantness and a rift between John and Kichu.
Unnikrishnan is forced to move to the city after he beats up some thugs for his foster family. In the city, he starts working for Ganapathy Iyer, a rich man who is seeking his long-lost lover.
Dr. Ruben Isaac takes up a position in a psychiatric hospital and uses humanitarian methods to treat his patients. However, things take a turn when his real identity is uncovered.
Anandakkuttan's life as a young artist takes a dramatic turn when he takes his autistic brother under his wing, leading to an unexpected yet heartwarming bond between them.
Velayudhan, an orphan, is loved by the villagers as he keeps the village free from unsavoury people and practices. However, an evil moneylender and politician get jealous and try to get rid of him.
A group of college friends meet after many years for a class reunion. However, due to some unexpected turn of events, several dark secrets are revealed, which changes their lives.
A poor tour guide from Kerala takes an American client on a journey through India. During their travels, the changing landscapes and experiences help them reshape their understanding of each other.

When a modest family with hidden martial arts skills crosses paths with a ruthless gang, they must unite to survive. Together, they fight against overwhelming odds in a thrilling and emotional battle.
Pulikkattil, an affluent family man, is forced to bear the brunt and burden of his late father's unscrupulous past. Now, Karnan, a jail convict, decides to settle some old scores with him.

Narayankutty wishes to be a lawyer but ends up being a clerk in a government office. However, when he sees the law being breached or misused, he does not hesitate to raise his voice against it.
Sadasivan comes across a house where the owner, Kumaran, has committed suicide to protect his wife, Soumini. However, what is even stranger is that a man who is visually challenged is always around.
Without knowing the risk of his work, a man goes to a village to dig a well as they are facing water scarcity. However, his life takes a turn when he falls in love with a girl.
Kunjava and his mate welcome a tail-wagging friend called Neymar, only to find their lives thrown into complete disarray.
Johnny pretends to be a gentleman but is a thief who thrives on lies and betrayals. His life turns upside down after his encounter with Adam, an orphan.
Ullas schemes to marry Simran, a woman with a disability, to avoid repaying a debt, but faces complications when Laya, a wealthy alcoholic, enters his life, turning his plans upside down.
Vineeth, a magazine reporter, lacks the inspiration to work hard. However, his life takes a turn when he is asked to interview a family court lawyer.
A young aspiring film director who seeks to make his directorial debut decides to use a real-life gangster as inspiration for his first movie.
A man sets out to investigate the death of his brother at a haunted house, leading him to come across several supernatural experiences.

Two orphans cause mischief to earn their daily bread, but their lives change when a woman seeks their help to save her brother.

When a powerful explosion occurs at the Vilayam beach seconds after Chief Minister Madhavan leaves the venue, Police Officer Rishikesh is tasked with the investigation to find the truth behind the blast.
As Venu's dream is to secure an MBBS admission for his daughter, he decides to sell his property to get money for her education. However, his family members try to disrupt his plans.
Three men compete against each other to win the affections of a beautiful woman. However, complications arise when her mother suffers from a heart attack.
Seasoned cop Abraham Ozler delves into an enigmatic cold case, sparking a relentless pursuit of a cunning serial killer.
Shaji Pappan and his team participate in a tug-of-war tournament to overcome their financial crisis. However, fate entangles them in a counterfeiting deal.
Tehsildar Paul Mathai who visits his daughter's home for a short while decides to extend his stay after observing something is amiss.
A renegade operative competes with the clock to prevent a nuclear disaster.
Three cousins, Divya, Krishnan and Arjuna, share a close bond and decide to move to Bangalore to fulfil their childhood dreams. There, they face challenges that will change their lives forever.

Aymanam Sidharthan, a leader of the youth wing of a local political party, hopes to succeed in politics. Irene, an Indo-Canadian woman making a documentary on Indian politics, is smitten with him.
Seelabhati along with her mother visits a remote village where she starts working as a computer teacher. When some students mysteriously disappear, the villagers start blaming her educational course.
Gautham is a young and successful businessman. His life dramatically changes when he meets Nithya, a girl who is suffering from short-term memory loss.
The life of an ordinary driver Keshu turns upside down when he wins a lottery worth 12 crores, but his morality gets tested.
Prince remains a bachelor, despite his good qualities, However, chaos follows when he marries a woman who is his polar opposite.
A young man eagerly awaits his wedding, but fate twists cruelly, forcing him into a lifelong bond with a woman who harbours nothing but resentment for him.
The demise of the leader of a political party leads to a massive power struggle. Amidst the chaos, a mystical man named Stephen comes in to ascend the throne.
A health worker in Wayanad copes with personal issues while caring for his bedridden brother. However, his quiet life is shattered when an armed fugitive demands shelter from the police.
When Binto learns of his brother Shinto's disappearance, his search for Shinto leads him to collaborate with others, resulting in unforeseen turns, revelations, and memorable experiences.

In the densely populated city of Cochin, a couple struggles through the process of finding the right fertility treatment for them.
Shaji Pappan's team emerges victorious in a tug of war competition, earning a cash prize, a trophy, and a female goat. However, the situation takes a turn when the team decides to slaughter the goat.
A man struggling to arrange money for his mother's treatment takes off on a spontaneous journey with a spendthrift he met at a bus stop.
Aby, who was abandoned at his wedding, meets a withdrawn woman in need of help. Together, they embark on a healing journey, until his former lover returns and offers a new perspective on his dreams.
Having been rejected once, Sachin, a young man, falls for Reenu, a girl he meets during a wedding and sets out to win her over.
Stephen Nedumpally, a mystifying leader of the crime world, must lead a double life to protect his world by rekindling some old memories.
Jaison, a young tailor, gains superpowers after being struck by lightning. However, he must thwart the evil intentions of an unexpected adversary to become the superhero that his rural village needs.
Four engineering students battle their professor's supernatural schemes to control the campus, encountering cursed gadgets and bizarre scenarios along the way.
Desperate to bring his family out of monetary woes, Bhaskar Kumar, a bank employee, enters the dangerous and murky world of financial scams.

After being forsaken by his mother in a temple, Aravindan, a five-year-old boy, is taken in by a hotelier. Against all odds, Aravindan clings to the hope of reuniting with his mother.
Dinesh, a conceited and wealthy young bachelor, goes to extreme lengths to impress a girl named Shobha with the help of his best friend Sagar, and Dinesh eventually hopes to marry Shobha.
A police constable reprimands his son for cheating on his school exams. However, he finds himself resorting to similar tactics when he takes a test that could land him a promotion.
Four people, a supermarket employee, a little girl, a housewife and a college student, deal with their everyday problems in life and try their best to overcome them.
A group of seven men attempt to conduct a seance, only to find themselves in a predicament when a spirit begins to answer their queries.
After a past incident, two powerful clans of Krishnapuram remain estranged until one day, a man with a mysterious past decides to bring the families together.
Sujatha, a single mother who struggles to make ends meet, is disappointed when her daughter Athira decides to drop out of school. So Sujatha devises a plan to motivate her to study.
Two close friends, John and Kurian, wish to take their friendship one step further and get their children married. However, they are unaware of the lives their children lead in the city.
When Karkotakudu, a monster, attempts to destroy Earth to take control of the planet, Rajeshwari, a devotee of Goddess Akkamma, decides to fight the behemoth.
When Karkotakudu, a monster, attempts to destroy Earth to take control of the planet, Rajeshwari, a devotee of Goddess Akkamma, decides to fight the behemoth.

An illicit relationship between a Kathakali dancer and a young woman from an upper caste family results in an illegitimate baby. The dancer's worries stockpile when he is barred from seeing his child.
Notorious for his relationships with women, a single Kuttiyappan's life takes a turn when he sets out to fulfil one of his strange dreams.
Aby realises that he is in love with Sona, his childhood friend, but is unable to express his feelings. However, he faces a dilemma when he learns that her marriage has already been arranged.
A dysfunctional family travels to Varanasi in order to fulfil their grandfather's wish. However, the journey ends up being a life-altering one for them.
A struggling director gets cheated by his friend who steals his script and becomes a famous actor. However, when he finally gets the chance to direct a film, he is forced to cast a dubious actor.
Upon arriving in a tribal region, Varghese Peter, a police constable, encounters complications as he discovers the distressing hardships endured by the local communities.
Mathews owns a farm that is the envy of everyone in the village. It attracts the attention of a dirty land dealer, who entangles him in a vicious bureaucratic web to take it away from him.
Robert, Dony and Xavier grow up together while honing their fighting skills. However, after an incident separates them for several years, an attack on their family reunites the three friends.
Barroz, a loyal servant, is compelled by magic to guard Cristovao da Gama's treasure for four centuries, waiting for a true heir to claim it.
Barroz, a loyal servant, is compelled by magic to guard Cristovao da Gama's treasure for four centuries, waiting for a true heir to claim it.
Ravishankar pretends to own the farmhouse of his friend Dennis when his relatives pay a visit along with their granddaughters. Chaos ensues after his prospective bride confesses her love for Dennis.
Friends Chacko and Hari are fed up with their employer and plan a trip to Goa. Their trip turns into something unusual when they discover a mysterious bag.

The villagers of Vellimala force the government to build a dam in their village. However, when the dam becomes unsafe, the government decides to destroy it, leading to violent protests by the villagers.
When his father asks him to manage their grocery store, Umesh runs away to Chennai to become a film-maker. His life changes after he takes a selfie with his old neighbour and posts it online.
While on holiday in Rome, Samantha meets Kittu, a man who has a sudden spark of fondness for her. Events take a surprising turn when Kittu insists she go with him to India.

Jaison, a teenager, has a crush on Keerthy, but she does not reciprocate his feelings. To make things worse, he gets in trouble with Ravi, the new teacher who is liked by everyone, especially Keerthy.
Radha and Sasikumar fall in love with each other. However, her life takes a turn when he refuses to marry her because of his family problems.
Madhavan is an honest and hardworking man. However, when a rich man's daughter, Eliana, asks him to abduct her and demand a ransom from her father, his life turns upside down.
While George's first love disappoints him, Malar, a college lecturer, restores his faith in love. His romantic journey takes him through several stages and helps him find his purpose.
